cues: Rigid, templated section structure: Classification/constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, First end-to-end slice (Phase 0), Phases, Validation checks, Cross-cutting, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Pervasive explicit labeling of ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN / REQUIREMENT / ASSUMED tags on budgets and claims, plus a 'Missing inputs' list stating how each changes the plan
Decisions table with reversibility classes (R2/R3), default, assumption, validated-by, and revisit trigger columns
Numbered validation checks V0–V9, each with hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence, unlocks/if-fails, and phase, referenced throughout phases as exit checks
Boilerplate sections like 'AI layer: N/A', 'Exceptions: None', 'Every dependency kind has at least one instance', and a per-phase security/observability/reproducibility/resilience matrix
